question: V100 16GB memory breakdown model weights activation buffer vLLM

sources.title: NVIDIA Tesla V100 PCIe 16 GB Specs | TechPowerUp GPU Database
sources.snippet: NVIDIA has paired 16 GB HBM2 memory with the Tesla V100 PCIe 16 GB, which is connected using a 4096-bit memory interface. The GPU is operating at a frequency of 1245 MHz, which can be boosted up to 1380 MHz, memory is running at 876 MHz (1752 Mbps effective).

sources.title: NVIDIA Tesla V100 SXM2 16 GB Specs - TechPowerUp
sources.snippet: NVIDIA has paired 16 GB HBM2 memory with the Tesla V100 SXM2 16 GB, which is connected using a 4096-bit memory interface. The GPU is operating at a frequency of 1312 MHz, which can be boosted up to 1530 MHz, memory is running at 876 MHz (1752 Mbps effective).
